source: page 1 of two-column.pdf (pdftotext -f 1 -l 1) for the text; the generator eval/scorecard/fixtures/rotated_scan.sh turns the 150 dpi grayscale raster 180 degrees (ImageMagick -rotate 180)
notes: The page is page 1 of pdf-two-column upside down; the correct reading is the upright page: title, byline, heading '1. West Egg', then the nine paragraphs that start on page 1 in column order (left column top to bottom, then right column).
Headings: title level 0, '1. West Egg' level 1.
The header line and 'Page 1' are furniture; the footnote at the foot of the left column is not an anchor.
Same headings and anchors as pdf-rotated-scan: only the turn differs.
The byline anchor starts at 'Scott': the raster's small italic 'F.' loses its period to recognition jitter on some turns, and an anchor must not hinge on one glyph.
